sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:25

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:25:1
items.html: In Arich Anpin and Atik, the male took all the MA, and the female took all the BON: For the male of Atik is the level of Keter, which emerged upon the bottom Hey that had descended from the forehead to the Peh [mouth], and it is the new MA. For all the lights that emerged through couplings in the world of Atzilut are called by the name HaVaYaH of MA, and all the lights and vessels whose coupling was made in the world of Nekudim are called by the name HaVaYaH of BON. Therefore the point of Keter of the world of Nekudim, whose upper half Atik took as his Nukva, is regarded as HaVaYaH of BON. Thus the male is MA alone and the female is BON alone. And in the same way, the male of AA is the level of Hochma, which emerged upon phase three in the world of Atzilut, and hence he is MA, as above. And his female is the lower half of the point of Keter of the world of Nekudim, and hence she is entirely BON.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:25:2
items.html: She is sweetened and does not need him: That is to say, the event of the breaking of the vessels did not touch the Sefira of Keter of Nekudim at all, and she has all the light that emerged with her at the beginning of her emanation. Hence she is sweetened of herself and does not need the MA to correct her. And with respect to the coupling of Katnut [smallness], she does not even need to receive light from the new MA, for her light is then more important than the MA, since she is of the bottom Hey in the Einayim, as above (page 614, the passage beginning “And the essence”). However, from the side of Gadlut [greatness] she receives her GAR [first three] from the MA, as written there.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:25:3
items.html: From AVI onward, the males had to first take the BON of the female, even the Katnut within her, in order to sweeten it: Since there was a nullification in their posterior on account of the breaking of the vessels, therefore, even when they are in the coupling of Katnut, the BON needs the sweetening of the new light of Katnut of the MA. Hence, before it comes to the Partzuf of the female, the BON had to join with the male inside his own vessels of MA, in order to sweeten it and complete it, and after that the male bestows the BON upon the vessels of the female. And the male is regarded as the upper one in relation to the female, even at the time of Katnut. Hence it is regarded that the root of the BON remains in the male, and that only a branch of it goes out to the female. This is as is known with every upper one and lower one: although the light belongs entirely to the lower one, still, since it passes by way of the upper one, the essence of the light remains in the upper one, and only a branch of it is bestowed upon the lower one.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:25:4
items.html: And its root from the Katnut remained within them: That is to say, a root of BON remained in the males because they received it first at the time of Katnut. Hence, although they afterwards gave it to their Nukva, the essence of the light remained in the males, as above in the adjacent item.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:25:5
items.html: And the MA, only its illumination, etc., and not the root, for the root remains within him: The meaning is that there is here an inclusion of the female in the male. Since the BON comes first to the male, it is found to be included with the MA that is in the male, and hence the BON receives the illumination of the MA. And afterwards, when it is bestowed upon the vessels of the female, the female too has the lights of MA. However, the essence in her is the name BON. But in the male it is the opposite, for the essence in him is the lights of MA, and the BON that he took on account of the inclusion of the female in him is regarded in him as illumination alone, and not as the essence.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:25:6
items.html: His mind is complete, etc., but the female, etc., her mind is light even in Gadlut: For the male has Hassadim and Gevurot in wholeness, since the Hassadim are from MA and the Gevurot are from BON; and since the root of the BON, too, remains in the male, the HG in his Daat are in wholeness. But the female, who has nothing of the self of the MA, which are the Hassadim in Daat, but only an illumination alone, therefore her mind is light.
